body:
Only Delhi's primary schools have moved classes online. Schools in Noida and Gurugram stay open, a correction to an earlier update says.

The earlier update, at 11:35 IST on 2 Nov, said schools across Delhi NCR had moved online until Friday. The correction, at 09:20 IST on 3 Nov, limits that to Delhi's primary schools. That matters to families in Noida and Gurugram, whose schools are open.

Known, from the updates: air-quality readings in Delhi, Noida and Gurugram passed 450, the 'severe' level, on Monday. Building work has stopped and diesel trucks are kept out of Delhi under the emergency rules, which also ask offices to let staff work from home where they can.

Not confirmed: how long Delhi's primary schools stay online. 'Until Friday' came with the earlier update; the correction doesn't repeat it.
